senses.gloss:
भित्त, अम्, n. a fragment, broken piece, bit; a
part, portion; = भित्ति, a partition, wall.

भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, frightened, alarmed, terrified,
afraid, fearful, timid; placed in jeopardy or danger,
imperiled, (often at the end of a comp., e. g. अग्नि-
भ्˚, afraid of fire; मृत्यु-भ्˚); (अम्), n. fear,
alarm, apprehension; (अम्), ind. timidly.
—भीतङ्-
कार, अस्, आ, अम्, making afraid; (अम्), ind. making
a coward, calling a coward, (तम् भीतङ्-कारम्
आक्रुश्य, calling him a coward.)
—भीत-परित्राण-
वस्तूपालम्भ-पण्डित (˚तु-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
clever in finding fault with the means of rescuing
the terrified.
—भीत-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, very much
frightened, exceedingly afraid.
—१. भीत-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, one who is afraid.
—२. भीत-वत्, ind. like
a frightened person, timidly.

भित्ति, इस्, f. breaking, splitting, tearing, dividing;
a wall of earth or masonry, a partition; a mat (made
of split reeds); anything broken or divided; a rent,
fissure; a fragment, bit, piece, portion, part; a place,
spot; a flaw, defect, deficiency; an opportunity,
occasion; an asylum (?).
—भित्ति-खातन, अस्, m.
‘wall-digger,’ one who digs into or undermines
walls, a rat; [cf. भित्ति-पातन.]
—भित्ति-चौर,
अस्, m. ‘wall-burglar,’ a house-breaker (the mud wall
of the Hindū cottages being easily cut through by
burglars).
—भित्ति-पातन, अस्, m. ‘wall-overthrower,
wall-destroyer,’ a kind of rat; [cf. भित्ति-खातन.]

भीति, इस्, f. fear, alarm, apprehension, dread,
terror, (often at the end of a comp., cf. दोष-भ्˚,
देव-भ्˚); tremor, trembling, shaking; danger.
—भीति-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing fear, exciting alarm.
—भीति-नाटितक, अम्, n. mimic representation of
fear.

भित्तिका, f. a partition, wall; a small house-
lizard; (अस्, आ, अम्) = भित्ति (at the end of an adj.
comp.).

भित्त्वा, ind. having broken, having split, having
burst through, &c.
